package __PACKAGE__.local;

import android.content.Context;
import org.json.JSONObject;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/** Debug-only local state store generated by the Mobile Workspace Editor. */
public final class LocalBackendStore {
    private static final String ASSET = "fallpoint-local-backend.json";
    private static final String FILE = "fallpoint-local-backend.json";

    private LocalBackendStore() {}
    public static boolean enabled() { return true; }

    public static JSONObject load(Context context) {
        try {
            File file = new File(context.getFilesDir(), FILE);
            if (file.isFile()) {
                try (InputStream in = new FileInputStream(file)) { return new JSONObject(readUtf8(in)); }
            }
            try (InputStream in = context.getAssets().open(ASSET)) {
                JSONObject seed = new JSONObject(readUtf8(in));
                save(context, seed);
                return seed;
            }
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to load local single-player state", error);
        }
    }

    public static void save(Context context, JSONObject state) {
        try (FileOutputStream out = new FileOutputStream(new File(context.getFilesDir(), FILE))) {
            out.write(state.toString(2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        } catch (Exception error) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to save local single-player state", error);
        }
    }

    public static void reset(Context context) {
        File file = new File(context.getFilesDir(), FILE);
        if (file.exists() && !file.delete()) throw new IllegalStateException("Unable to reset local single-player state");
    }

    private static String readUtf8(InputStream in) throws Exception {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
        byte[] buffer = new byte[8192];
        int read;
        while ((read = in.read(buffer)) != -1) out.write(buffer, 0, read);
        return new String(out.toByteArray(), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
    }
}
